original.target_description: Original full paper not acquired within the per-paper acquisition window.

replication.target_description: Located p. 4 Hypothesis 1: Republicans versus Democrats selecting which inauguration photo has more people. This is crowd-size judgment, not identifying which candidate’s inauguration a picture depicts.

n.sample_role: Participants: 422 Republicans and 532 Democrats, including leaners; full post-exclusion sample for Hypothesis 1.
n.exclusions: Excluded survey duration <5 or >60 minutes, age <18 or >100, duplicate IP, and non-USA IP; complete data for 1018 before exclusions.
n.quote: After exclusions, the final sample included 954 participants

reported_success.location: p. 4, Procedure and Results; p. 6, Discussion

notes: Supplied outcome is picture identification. The replication p. 4 locator instead concerns which photo has more people; Procedure describes that crowd-size task, not identification of whose inauguration is pictured. Located test values are preserved with target_match false; no authors’ success verdict for an inauguration-identification replication is established. If picture identification was intended merely as a synonym for crowd-size selection, Hypothesis 1 is the same test as in 1063. Original full text unavailable, so the original identification outcome cannot be verified.
